Hi Marcus,

Thanks for the quick intro call earlier. Attached is our completed onboarding form (OptiStack-Onboarding-Form.pdf) and a CSV export of the pricing buckets we expect to consume in month 1 (lineitem-correction-sample.csv). A few items we need your help with before we can start provisioning: 

- PO number issuance: Procurement at our side requires a purchase reference tied to the subscription start date. Can you confirm the next available PO serial and whether you can backdate to 2026-05-01?

- Line-item mapping: The CSV has 4 SKUs but your onboarding portal mapped two together. We need the invoice line items to match our internal charge codes; can you route this to procurement for a line-item correction?

We can sign any minimal amendment or provisional PO stub if that helps. CC'd Carlos from ProcureCo who will coordinate on their side.

Appreciate the help — Sophie

Hi all — thanks for the details. Internal procurement summary and next steps below.

1) PO serials
- We can reserve a provisional reference (PROV-4387) today so OptiStack can commence work. Final PO serial will be assigned after we validate the signed SOW and vendor tax form (W-8/W-9). Estimated final serial by 2026-05-18 EOD.

2) Backdating
- We will accept backdate to 2026-05-01 provided there is a note in the procurement system linking charges to the provisional serial and the finance team approves. I've flagged with accounting; they requested a one-line memo from OptiStack confirming dates.

3) Spend cap and guardrail
- We can place a temporary spend guard at $30,000/month but to meet OptiStack's requested $25,000 we need CFO approval. Ben, any flexibility from commercial to accept a $30k provisional guard with a promise to drop to $25k after month 1?

4) Line-item corrections
- Marcus, I looked at the portal mapping — sku-A and sku-B were collapsed because they shared the same billing code. We can create two invoice lines linked to sku-A (code AST-001) and sku-B (code AST-002). Sophie, please confirm the exact charge codes you want for each row in your CSV; once confirmed procurement will issue a mapping ticket and attach the corrected line-item manifest to the PO.

Attachments: procurement-checklist.pdf (stub)

- Sophie: send confirmation of billing contact, dates memo, and explicit charge code for each SKU (reply inline)
- Marcus: raise provisional PO PROV-4387 in the system and share the temporary PO stub with OptiStack by EOD 2026-05-14
- Ben: advise on the $30k provisional guard approval timeline
